acceptance: The record states each signal with its date range and source, or says plainly that access was not available.
It recommends unblock, keep blocked or drop for each of the three blocked items, with the number that supports it.
It states the baseline taken on 2026-11-13: about 393 PyPI downloads in a month, three issues ever from outside contributors, and no benchbox.dev page in a comparison search.
context: No paid model calls and no scored agent sessions under this item. Guardrails: work only in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items are delivered together on one feature branch and one PR, as their umbrella item names (site work: BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site); squash-merged. Add a changelog.d fragment for any user-facing change. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers) runs only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy (make comment-policy-check). Stop and report instead of widening scope; scope removed during review must be re-homed to a named item or dropped by the owner with a reason.
description:
Problem: nothing shows whether assistants or coding agents reach BenchBox. A scored probe was planned and dropped: its thresholds could pass or fail by chance, and it would have run before the result permalinks were fixed.

Outcome: a short record of free demand signals, taken six to eight weeks after the static result pages ship: search impressions and clicks for /result-summaries/ and /results/r/ pages (Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools), GitHub traffic referrers that are assistants (for example chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai, claude.ai), and PyPI downloads by installer and system. The record ends with a recommendation on each blocked item: site-summary-pages-comparison-context-20261112, publish-result-bundle-json-schema-20261112, site-llms-txt-and-markdown-docs-20261113.

Owner input needed: access to Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools and to the repositories' traffic pages.
